rationale: Alpha Vantage documents a dedicated GOLD_SILVER_SPOT endpoint for live gold/silver spot prices.
Alpha Vantage terms require commercial-use agreement for business/investment-analysis use; therefore adapter remains disabled until rights are confirmed.
Metals-API documents real-time precious metals data and bid/ask symbols, making it useful as a challenger/cross-check candidate.
Metals-API free plan is testing/personal only; paid plans permit commercial/public use during active subscription, but its competition restriction requires legal/product-fit review before production.

pilot_routes.reason: Avoid automated collection until terms/access rights are reviewed.
Independent observed route; semantics must be recorded (bid/ask/reference, timestamp, settlement).

prohibited: Do not scrape sources whose automation rights are unresolved.
Do not store API keys in repository or decision records.
Do not claim provider independence if both routes share the same upstream feed.
Do not promote any candidate to production merely because an adapter works technically.
